setup_masked_lm_task: setup a MaskedLMTask from args to train BERT or RoBERTa style masked language models
load_masked_lm_dataset: load a masked LM dataset split with token blocking and masking applied for training
build_inference_dataset: build a dataset for inference from source tokens and lengths using TokenBlockDataset
configure_masking_args: configure masking arguments like mask-prob, leave-unmasked-prob, and random-token-prob for the task
review_masked_lm_task: review the MaskedLMTask class and its load_dataset method for masked language model training
